title: After an upgrade, a worker's CLI inside its sandbox runs status and complete without a version refusal
description: A CLI release named for an old commit is upgraded in place to a new one, and the upgrade writes the new commit into the release. Inside a worker sandbox git cannot read the release, yet its CLI reports the new commit: status succeeds and complete meets no 'CLI commit X and server commit Y differ' refusal.

steps.name: a sandboxed CLI runs status and complete after an in-place upgrade
